create.name: The Divine Life Society Malaysia (Sivanandashram, Batu Caves)
create.bio:
The Divine Life Society's Malaysian branch keeps its Sivanandashram on Jalan Batu Caves in Selangor, a few kilometres north of Kuala Lumpur. It follows the teaching of Swami Sivananda of Rishikesh, summed up in his motto Serve, Love, Give, Purify, Meditate, Realize, and welcomes people of every faith who want a life of service, self-discipline, enquiry and meditation. Swamis of the order lead its management and teaching, and the movement counts some twenty sub-branches around the country.

At the ashram there is a weekly hatha yoga class on Saturday afternoons and a timetable of scripture study led by resident swamis: Swami Sivananda's teachings on the first Saturday, Gita chanting and Sivapuranam classes on other Saturdays, Sanskrit and a Bhagavad Gita class with chanting on Sundays, and an online Vivekachudamani class on Saturday evenings. Since 1988 it has trained spiritual tutors to teach in the community, and it runs youth camps and festival celebrations such as Navaratri and Deepavali. Service is central: the society runs a home, a charitable clinic and food drives for families in need around Gombak. Its website also carries short writings by Swami Sivananda on practices such as japa.
